P.name: Echoing Flames
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Urgot's''' six legs each conceal a shotgun that covers an arc, together forming a full circle of cover around him. Each shotgun can fire once before incurring a unique {{sti|cooldown}}.
P.description2: '''Urgot's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} within the arc of a shotgun will cause it to fire in a cone, dealing {{as|{{pp|key=%|40 to 100 for 6|1;6;9;11;13;15}} AD}} {{as|(+ {{pp|changedisplay=true|key=%|2 to 6 for 5|1 to 13}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, capped at {{pp|100 + (360-100)/17*(x-1) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Corrosive Charge
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Urgot''' launches a canister at the target location. Upon landing, it explodes after {{fd|0.3}} seconds to deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow}} them for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.

W.name: Purge
W.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Urgot's''' other abilities ''mark'' enemy {{tip|champions}} hit for 5 seconds. Only one enemy can be ''marked'' at a time.

Additionally, at maximum rank, ''Purge'' lasts indefinitely and becomes a toggled ability.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Urgot''' equips his machine gun for 4 seconds, granting {{tip|ghosting}} to minions and non-epic monsters around him and autonomously firing at the nearest enemy at a '''fixed''' {{sti|attack speed|{{as|{{fd|3.0}} attack speed}}}}, prioritizing ''marked'' enemy champions and refreshing the ''mark'' with every attack. While firing, '''Urgot''' is able to move and gains 40% {{tip|slow resist}}, but his {{as|movement speed}} is reduced by {{as|125|ms}}.
W.description3: Attacks with ''Purge'' deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}}, with a minimum threshold of 50 against {{tip|monsters}} and {{tip|minions}}, and cannot {{tip|critically strike}}. Each attack applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects, with on-hit and on-attack damage reduced to 50% effectiveness. '''Urgot''' cannot perform attacks while affected by {{tip|disarming crowd control}}.
W.description4: ''Purge'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

E.name: Disdain
E.description2: After the cast time, '''Urgot''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through, {{tip|airborne|knocking them aside}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second.
E.description3: '''Urgot''' will stop upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and, after {{fd|0.25}} seconds, also {{tip|airborne|flinging}} them to the location {{tt|100 units behind him|This destination is a fixed location and is unaffected by size modifiers on Urgot or the target moving away before the displacement started}}, though not through terrain.
E.description4: ''{{ai|Purge|Urgot}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Fear Beyond Death
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Urgot''' fires a chem-drill in the target direction that impales the first enemy champion hit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and leashing the target for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 75 for 11|key1=%|0 to 75|formula=1% per 1% missing health. ''This is capped at 75%''}}|health}}.
R.description2: ''Fear Beyond Death'' can be recast if the leashed target is below {{as|{{sti|health|25% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}, and does so automatically if the chem-drill {{tt|would kill the target|Damage instance does not reduce their health below 1 in this case}}, the ability is cast again while the target was above the threshold and is then brought within it, or the target is within the threshold at the end of the duration.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Mercy:}} '''Urgot''' launches chains at the leashed target, then {{tip|channel|channels}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds once they latch on. During this time, he reels them toward him, {{tip|suppression|suppressing}} them, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them, rendering them {{tip|untargetable}}, and preventing them from taking damage from {{tt|other sources|Negates application of damage from any source that is not the execution}}. If the target is near '''Urgot''' when the chains connect, they are pushed up to {{tt|1000|Estimated}} units away based on their proximity to him. This channel cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
R.description4: Upon completing the channel, the target is {{ccs|{{tip|execute|executed}}|true}}. If the execution is successful, he {{tip|fear|fears}} nearby enemies for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 75%.
R.description5: ''Fear Beyond Death's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. '''Urgot''' can move while channeling Fear Beyond Death's recast.''
